{{Top|leg}}
'''Airtrucks''' were a type of air vehicle in use on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Airtrucks had an open bed, and were capable of transporting at least five individuals. The [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group known as [[the Flail]] used an airtruck to deploy a strike team to the [[Weather Modulation Control Center]] in an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="Shadows">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref>
